# Synthetic input fixtures

Generated by FlowValue tests, not copies of a private engineering study.
The fixtures cover row tables, column tables, multiple worksheets and repeated
Nottingham-style headers. Numerical values are synthetic; they are not equipment
prices or validation benchmarks for an industrial plant. See
`backend/tests/test_automatic_equipment_inputs.py` for reproducible generation
and the actual Python sizing/costing assertions. No macros or vendor code included.
